THE PROBLEM: DROWNING IN ENVIRONMENTAL NOISE
Why Detecting Genuine Planetary Trajectories is Difficult for Citizens and Scientists

1. Data Fragmentation & Silos
Terabytes of vital telemetry scattered across disparate databases (PODAAC, GES DISC, Earthdata, NSIDC), making holistic system analysis nearly impossible for non-specialists.

2. Signal vs. Noise Dilemma
Short-term weather oscillations (ENSO, seasonal anomalies, volcanic aerosols) mask authentic, decadal climate trends, leading to widespread misinterpretation.

3. The Regional Divergence Paradox
A single underlying forcing (global warming) causes opposite physical responses simultaneously (e.g. Arctic greening vs. Amazon drying; polar ice loss vs. post-glacial rebound).

4. The Public Accessibility Barrier
Complex mathematical formats and gated academic tools prevent students, educators, and journalists from verifying empirical climate evidence directly.
NASA Space Apps 2026 Objective: Answer What, Where, How Much, and Is It Significant?

Our planet's vital signs are changing, but raw telemetry is vast and fragmented. Citizen scientists and students often struggle to separate temporary weather noise from authentic, statistically significant planetary trends.

SCIENTIFIC RIGOR & NASA DATA INTEGRATION
Primary Satellite Telemetry Validated Through Non-Parametric Statistics

PRIMARY NASA DATA STREAMS

• NASA GISTEMP v4: Surface temperature anomalies (+1.39°C global mean warming)
• NASA/GFZ GRACE & GRACE-FO: Gravimetric mass balance (-270 Gt/yr Greenland, -135 Gt/yr Antarctic ice loss)
• Sentinel-6 & Jason-3: Radar altimetry (+4.2 mm/yr sea level rise)
• NASA OCO-2 & NOAA GML: Atmospheric CO2 column densities (426 ppm)
• NASA MODIS Terra/Aqua: NDVI vegetation greening/browning

MATHEMATICAL FORENSIC SIEVE

• Mann-Kendall Monotonic Test: Non-parametric rank correlation proving non-random trajectory (p < 0.001)
• Sen's Slope Estimator: Robust median-based slope calculation resistant to sensor outliers
• Statistical Significance Locks: Verified at p < 0.05, p < 0.01, and p < 0.001 levels
• Noise Filtering: Prevents temporary seasonal anomalies from triggering false trend alarms
100% Scientifically Vetted: Turning Raw Satellite Data into Defensible Climate Intelligence
Every trend in Aether is mathematically validated. By implementing Mann-Kendall trend tests and Sen's slope calculations, Aether verifies non-random change with 99.9% scientific confidence.

Aether goes beyond typical surface maps. We introduce 3D interior cutaways to connect mantle convection with atmospheric retention, alongside a divergence lens that exposes Arctic amplification in real time.
